title: Fresh Apple Walnut Cake
description: This apple walnut cake makes a simple and delicious fall dessert. The cake is moist, lightly spiced, and loaded with walnuts and chunks of apples.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 9x13-inch pan. Sift flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt into a bowl; set aside.
Combine apples and white sugar in a separate bowl; set aside. Mix brown sugar, oil, eggs, and vanilla together until well combined. Stir in apple mixture, then flour mixture. Fold in walnuts.
Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean. Allow to cool.

video.description: Get into the autumn groove with a simple and delicious cake loaded with fresh apples and chopped walnuts. Mix a cake base of flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt. Then toss peeled, cored and sliced apples with sugar, then add brown sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla. Add your dry ingredients and fold in walnuts and bake. That’s it! The cake is moist and not too sweet and does not need an icing, though no one will be bothered if you do add one. The flavors also develop and taste even better when you try a slice the day after baking!
